evidence.title: SimilarSites - A little bit about us and SimilarWeb

name: SimilarSites.com
summary: Browser extension and site that find websites similar to the page you are browsing.
description: SimilarSites recommends alternative and competing websites from any URL, using 20+ similarity engines over content, keyword density, link structure, tagging and traffic data plus community ratings. Free to use through a browser extension or the website, with related tools such as the SimilarWeb and SimilarTech API.
contains: finds similar and alternative websites from any URL
20+ similarity engines: content, keyword density, tagging, link structure, traffic
part of SimilarGroup; related SimilarWeb tools
